dedupe_keys.name: san jose fire department incidents 2015 to present city of san jose open data

description: This dataset lists every incident of the San Jose Fire Department in California from 2015 to the present, one CSV file per year, published on the city's open data portal. Each row is an incident with its number, event time, dispatch time, unit en route time, unit on scene time and first unit on scene, cleared time, number of units, priority, final incident type (for example fire or medical) and category, street name, first-due station and battalion. The time stamps allow response intervals to be computed for each station and battalion. Coverage is the city of San Jose. The files are free to download under a Creative Commons CCZero dedication, and the 2026 file is updated during the year; the portal entry was refreshed in September 2026. Caveats: street names are given without house numbers or coordinates, so incidents can be located only to street and station area, cancelled calls are included, and incident categories changed over the years. Simulation uses: calibrating call arrival, dispatch and response time distributions in fire and emergency medical service models, and testing station coverage and relocation scenarios. Related records: the NFIRS public data (data-usfa-nfirs-public-data-release) give national fire incident records and the San Jose park amenities (data-san-jose-park-amenities-sports-fields) come from the same portal.
